def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    person_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    arm_patches = image_patch.find("arm")
    
    if not person_patches or not arm_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    person_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in person_patches]
    arm_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in arm_patches]
    
    max_distance = -math.inf
    best_person_patch = None
    
    for person_center in person_centers:
        for arm_center in arm_centers:
            distance_x = abs(person_center[0] - arm_center[0])
            distance_y = abs(person_center[1] - arm_center[1])
            total_distance = math.sqrt(distance_x**2 + distance_y**2)
            
            if total_distance > max_distance:
                max_distance = total_distance
                best_person_patch = person_patches[person_centers.index(person_center)]
    
    return best_person_patch
